name: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 (Air)
short_description: A half-marathon event in Ermita, Manila, Philippines, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances on September 20, 2026.
ai_summary: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 20, 2026, in Ermita, Manila, Philippines. Organized by Green Media Events, the race offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, allowing participants of varying fitness levels to take part. Registration details have not yet been announced for this race.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) accommodate different runner levels
Organized by an established events organizer, Green Media Events
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
research_highlights: The Air Run leg of Takbo Para sa Kalikasan is the 3rd of a four-part 'element series' (Fire, Water, Air, Earth) organized by Green Media Events, with past Air Run editions held at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds in Pasay offering 5K, 10K, and 21K distance options.
The Air Run's environmental theme centers on bird diversity and conservation, with proceeds benefiting the Haribon Foundation's restoration projects.
The most recent Air Run 2025 edition drew a large turnout, reported as more than 6,000 runners.
Race kits for the Air Run distances have included an event singlet, race bib (with RFID timing for 10K/21K), finisher shirt, and an eco-friendly basswood finisher medal.
Past editions have had sponsor-run hydration/nutrition support on course (e.g., Herbalife shakes and hydration stations at the 2025 Air Run).

faqs.question: When is Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026. The event will be held in Ermita, Manila, in the Philippines, giving runners in the region a chance to participate in this half-marathon race on that specific date.

faqs.answer: Participants in Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 can choose from three distance options: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km race, or a 5km race. This range of distances allows both experienced runners and beginners to find a suitable challenge for their fitness level.
